map.按风险预算定仓：给定账户资金与单笔风险比例、止损点数，反推应开手数，使每次止损损: Size by risk budget: given account funds, per-trade risk ratio, and stop-loss pips, back-calculate the lots so each stop loss is fixed and controlled.
map.盈亏比规划：结合目标止盈点数，核算潜在盈利与盈亏比（R 倍数），筛选符合策略的設: Risk-reward planning: with target take-profit pips, compute potential profit and the risk-reward ratio (R multiple) to filter setups matching your strategy.
map.多品种适配：不同货币对点值不同（如 USD/JPY 一点=0.01），自动按所选: Multi-instrument fit: different pairs have different pip values (e.g. USD/JPY one pip=0.01); the lot size auto-converts by the selected pair’s pip value.
map.风险金额 = 余额 × 风险比例%；每点价值/手 = 100000 × 点大小: Risk amount = balance × risk ratio%; pip value/lot = 100000 × pip size ÷ quote-to-USD; risk per lot = stop-loss pips × pip value/lot; suggested lots = risk amount ÷ risk per lot (subject to max-lot limit); actual loss = suggested lots × risk per lot; potential profit = target pips × suggested lots × pip value/lot; risk-reward = target pips ÷ stop-loss pips.
map.账户 10000、风险 2%、EURUSD（点大小 0.0001）、止损 50: Account 10000, risk 2%, EURUSD (pip size 0.0001), stop 50 pips, quote-to-USD=1, target 100 pips, max 10 lots: risk amount=200; pip/lot=100000×0.0001÷1=10; risk per lot=50×10=500; suggested lots=200÷500=0.40 lots; actual loss=0.4×500=200 (2% risk); potential profit=100×0.4×10=400; risk-reward=2.
map.点值为什么除以报价货币兑 USD？: Why divide pip value by the quote-to-USD rate?
map.标准手 100000 单位的基础货币，乘以点大小得到报价货币计的点值，再除以报价: A standard lot is 100,000 units of base currency; times pip size gives the pip value in quote currency, then divided by quote-to-USD to express the risk in the account settlement currency (USD).
map.建议手数被最大手数截断怎么办？: What if the suggested lots are capped by the max-lot limit?
map.说明单笔风险设置相对账户过大或止损过宽；可缩小风险比例、收窄止损，或接受更低仓位: It means per-trade risk is too large for the account or the stop is too wide; reduce the risk ratio, tighten the stop, or accept a smaller position — never exceed the max-lot limit just to fill the account.
